text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President receives phone-calls, cables from Arab and world leaders condemning the terrorist bombing of a bus in Damascus by Israel's Mossad secret service.
- President's commiseration conveyed by premier to victims of the Damascus bus explosion.
- President Assad accepts credentials of new ambassadors of North Korea, Chile and Poland.
- Vice-President Khaddam discusses regional developments with delegation of Jordanian Islamic parties.
- Israel admits escalation of resistance against occupation in the golan.
- Lebanese resistance units attack Israeli occupation troops in south Lebanon. Israel admits injury of three soldiers.
